text:
rebecca: quick FYI 0min post-RBAC tidy our monorepo SAST runner spiked alerts and we can't find any KMS decrypt audit lines for the CI principal. tagging @omar @jing for a short triage. logs below.

omar: on it. short hypothesis: the RBAC tidy replaced the old group binding with a narrow group and the CI SA lost roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter and/or storage.objectViewer. alternately the logging sink might be filtering infra serviceAccount principals.

jing: can you paste the runner errors?

rebecca: runner stderr: 
```
2026-12-09T07:11:03Z suppressor: GET https://configs.corp/suppress.json 403
2026-12-09T07:11:04Z unwrapper: kms decrypt error: PermissionDenied
2026-12-09T07:11:05Z scanner: running without suppressions -> alerts spiked to 91
```

omar: mitigation plan (short): 1) ephemeral grant to CI SA for cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter + storage.objectViewer (30m). 2) re-run SAST. 3) check KMS audit and logging sink filters. example gclouds:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/PRJ/locations/global/keyR/keys/scan-suppress \
  --member=serviceAccount:ci-runner@prj.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter

gsutil iam ch serviceAccount:ci-runner@prj.iam.gserviceaccount.com:objectViewer gs://configs.corp
```

infra-admin: applied ephemeral grants at 07:26 UTC and created SEC-6123 to track permanent fixes. re-run: suppressions fetched, KMS Decrypt audit shows principal=serviceAccount:ci-runner@prj at 07:26:41, alerts dropped 91 -> 7.

audit-bot: SEC-6123 created and audit evidence attached.

jing: next steps (short): - INFRA: add permanent least-priv binding for ci-runner on the single key + bucket and document the reason. - INFRA: remove over-broad logging sink exclusion (don't drop cloudkms audit for infra principals). - DEVSEC: add a tiny GH preflight step that verifies a test KMS decrypt and suppression fetch before running the full scanner; fail fast. - DEVSEC: add a repo-level fallback suppressions file (signed) so builds aren't dependent on one external SA ACL.

rebecca: agreed. I'll open SEC-6124 for the GH preflight PR and link to SEC-6123. keeping this thread short; closing after PR and infra tickets are linked :thumbsup:
